branch_protection_instructions.instruction_2: Click "Add branch ruleset" or "Add rule" for branch pattern "master"
branch_protection_instructions.instruction_3: Enable "Require a pull request before merging"
branch_protection_instructions.instruction_4: Enable "Require status checks to pass before merging"
branch_protection_instructions.instruction_5: Select check: "Deterministic Build, Typecheck, Test & Audit"
